scenes.text: Beep boop! Congratulations! You got admitted!
scenes.caption: Beep boop! Congratulations! You got admitted!

scenes.text: Welcome to the next chapter. I'm Sprout, and I want you to still know this stuff in four years.
scenes.caption: Welcome to the next chapter. I'm Sprout, and I want you to still know this stuff in four years.

scenes.text: Here's how first year usually goes. Lectures fly by. Notes pile up. Then it's eleven p.m., the test is tomorrow, and you have forty pages to read.
scenes.caption: Here's how first year usually goes. Lectures fly by. Notes pile up. Then it's eleven p.m., the test is tomorrow, and you have forty pages to read.

scenes.text: So you cram. You read it again and again until the words look familiar.
scenes.caption: So you cram. You read it again and again until the words look familiar.

scenes.text: Familiar is not the same as understood. The test comes, and you remember it. For a day.
scenes.caption: Familiar is not the same as understood. The test comes, and you remember it. For a day.

scenes.text: A week later it's gone. And then next semester builds on it. Nobody tells you that part.
scenes.caption: A week later it's gone. And then next semester builds on it. Nobody tells you that part.

scenes.text: Here's what I do instead. Drop in your notes, your slides, even a photo of the board. I turn them into lessons you can actually follow.
scenes.caption: Here's what I do instead. Drop in your notes, slides, or board photos. I turn them into lessons you can actually follow.

scenes.text: Stuck on a word? Tap it. I run over and pull the answer up in plain words, with an example.
scenes.caption: Stuck on a word? Tap it. I run over and pull the answer up in plain words, with an example.

scenes.text: Then I make you use it. Flashcards, quizzes, small challenges. Not copying. Explaining, choosing, building.
scenes.caption: Then I make you use it: flashcards, quizzes, small challenges. Explaining, choosing, building.

scenes.text: And I keep watch. A ten minute focus sprint when you can't settle. XP and a streak so you come back tomorrow, not just tonight.
scenes.caption: A 10-minute focus sprint when you can't settle. XP and streaks so you come back tomorrow.

scenes.text: Other tools give you the answer. I make you get it.
scenes.caption: Other tools give you the answer. I make you get it.

scenes.text: I notice what you find hard, so you spend your time there.
scenes.caption: I notice what you find hard, so you spend your time there.

scenes.text: Learn it once, properly, and the exams get easier too.
scenes.caption: Learn it once, properly, and the exams get easier too.

scenes.text: Congratulations again. Understand it. Build it. Prove it. SunrootLearn. Start free today. Let's go!
scenes.caption: Understand it. Build it. Prove it. SunrootLearn. Start free today. Let's go!
